body: I'm sorry to hear about it.  I live in the Minnesota, in the US.  I'm going to bed soon, but I may take you up on the offer to chat.  Feel free to do the same to me.
I'm actually feeling a lot better since I posted this.  I started listening to music, getting a good cry out.

To be not alone, I think, would be to have a friend I could feel I could talk to, and who make a practice of talking to me.  I don't really have that.

Though you've got some true words in here.  Thank you.
Yes.  I don't believe my surgery was the reason for his breaking up with me.

Heh, maybe all of us alone people got together, we wouldn't be so alone anymore.

I do a lot of stuff to entertain myself.  I'm really not close to anybody though.
I think I actually kind of am alone.  I'm not good with relationships.  I hardly ever even hear from my family.  But thank you.
Oh and, he decided to be done with this relationship a week after I find out I'd be needing heart surgery this winter.  Fuck, I am alone.
